$SPX Chart Update:

1) Clear and obvious rising channel with multiple touches to the upper bound channel line. Non-debatable that this is a huge technical level.

2) Currently notable RSI bearish divergence similar from Sept 2025-Mar 2026.

3) Did recently break below the mini orange support trendline. Friday we did do a backtest. But can it get over it now? Or will it act as resistance?

4) The lower bound channel line can act as a very likely back stop to any drawdowns for the remaining of the year with 76 trading days left. At any price, the SPX cannot drop any greater than 11% max if that line holds as true support (which I think it will if we do get that Tom Lee drawdown soon).

Did an interim top process/drawdown begin already since making a new ATH in mid August?

Are we going through a historically predictable period where we test new Fed Chair Warsh now with 5% rates and a midterms elections quickly incoming?

Personally, I would love to see a kiss off the lower blue rising channel line for a true and final BTFD moment for the remaining of 2026. At any point, we should remain well over the 7,000-7,100 mark if so.

Buy THAT dip.

-Heis
